pages.text: Bulk Mosquito! These powerful, mutated mosquito brethren retain their blood-draining abilities while gaining immense physical strength. Though they look dangerous, fortunately, they are completely loyal to you—as long as you're careful not to exceed the summoning limit...
You can right-click your Warped Mosco Servant with a Blood Sac to restore its health. Using a Hemolymph Sac restores even more health in one go.
Since Mungus blood can transform a mosquito into a Warped Mosco, what might happen if you were to use the blood of those pale Nether emissaries on a Warped Mosco...?
